title: feat: add build methodology section to ship briefs
body:
## What Changed

- Added "# Build methodology" section to ship briefs generated by `bin/fm-brief.sh`, following Definition of done with four beats: Isolate, Build, Prove, Ship, and delivery mode controls
- Added `test_ship_build_methodology` test in `tests/fm-brief.test.sh` that verifies the methodology section appears in all ship modes (no-mistakes, direct-PR, local-only) and is excluded from scout/secondmate scaffolds
- Simplified Definition of done extraction logic in `tests/fm-task-delivery.test.sh` to stop at the next top-level heading rather than using separate awk pipelines
